title: AI Agents for Packaged Food Brands: Investigate Grocery Short-Shipment Claims
summary: A Genie rebuilds ordered, shipped, and received case counts from NetSuite and Postgres for a grocery shortage claim and flags missing receipts for AR.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A grocery shortage Genie should reconstruct the requested, shipped, and received quantities at the retailer’s item and pack grain. Give it purchase-order, shipment, invoice, and receiving evidence with stable references. Its job is to produce a defensible investigation packet and identify missing facts before accounts receivable accepts or disputes the claim.


Explore the complete[packaged food and snacks integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/packaged-food-snacks) for the systems and processes around this guide.
